# "At the beginning of the end step, sacrifice this creature." — each end step (no actor), like
# Liliana's Scrounger's "At the beginning of each end step"; "this creature" is the IS_SOURCE pick.
end_step_sacrifice = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(phase=Phase.END_TURN),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.SACRIFICE, {
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [end_step_sacrifice, *compiled]
